# gpupaas_ssh_key (Resource)

An SSH public key (`dev.envmgmt.io/v1` `SshKey`), at project or workspace scope. Instances (VMs, bare metal, clusters) name a key of their workspace to install it. The platform has no update for a key: changing any argument deletes the key and creates it again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# An SSH key in a workspace. Instances in that workspace name it with `ssh_key`. The platform has no update
# for a key: a new public key replaces it.
resource "gpupaas_ssh_key" "admin" {
  metadata = {
    name      = "admin-key"
    project   = "system-catalog"
    workspace = "team-a"
  }

  spec = {
    public_key = file("~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub")
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Required

- `metadata` (Attributes) Where the SSH key lives. Changing any of these replaces it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metadata))
- `spec` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `<project>/<workspace>/<name>`, or `<project>/<name>` for a project-scoped key.
- `status` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--metadata"></a>
### Nested Schema for `metadata`

Required:

- `name` (String) Name of the SSH key.
- `project` (String) Project that owns the SSH key.

Optional:

- `workspace` (String) Workspace that owns the SSH key; omit for a project-scoped one. It must already exist.


<a id="nestedatt--spec"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec`

Required:

- `public_key` (String) The OpenSSH public key, for example the contents of `id_ed25519.pub`. Changing it replaces the key.

Optional:

- `sharing` (Attributes) Resource sharing across workspaces or projects. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing))

<a id="nestedatt--spec--sharing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.sharing`

Required:

- `share_mode` (String) Sharing mode (e.g. `ALL_WORKSPACES`, `SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`, `SPECIFIC_PROJECTS`).

Optional:

- `projects` (Attributes List) Project sharing entries when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_PROJECTS`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--spec--sharing--projects))
- `workspaces` (List of String) Workspaces shared with when `share_mode = SPECIFIC_WORKSPACES`.

<a id="nestedatt--spec--sharing--projects"></a>
### Nested Schema for `spec.sharing.projects`

Required:

- `name` (String)

Optional:

- `workspaces` (List of String)




<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `reason` (String)
- `status` (String) Platform status, `success` once the key is stored.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# <project>/<workspace>/<name>, or <project>/<name> for a project-scoped key
terraform import gpupaas_ssh_key.admin system-catalog/team-a/admin-key
```
